sql: SELECT 'foobar' LIKE 'foo%', 'foobar' NOT LIKE 'baz%', 'FooBar' ILIKE 'foo%', 'FooBar' NOT ILIKE 'baz%'
note: LIKE / NOT LIKE / ILIKE / NOT ILIKE basic forms
LIKE ESCAPE single char — escaping _ and %

sql: SELECT 'hello world' SIMILAR TO 'hello%', 'abc' SIMILAR TO '(a|b)+'
note: SIMILAR TO basic pattern with SQL regex alternation
SIMILAR TO with explicit ESCAPE clause
regexp_match, regexp_matches with g flag, regexp_replace with flags

sql: SELECT regexp_split_to_table('a,b,,c', ','), regexp_split_to_array('x:y:z', ':'), regexp_count('aabbaab', 'a+'), regexp_instr('foobarfoo', 'bar'), regexp_substr('foobarfoo', 'b.r'), regexp_like('Hello', 'h.*', 'i')
note: regexp_split_to_table, regexp_split_to_array, regexp_count, regexp_instr, regexp_substr, regexp_like (PG15+)

sql: SELECT substring('Thomas' FROM 2 FOR 3), substring('Thomas' SIMILAR '%#"o_a#"%' ESCAPE '#'), overlay('Txxxas' PLACING 'hom' FROM 2 FOR 3), position('om' IN 'Thomas'), strpos('Thomas', 'om')
note: substring FROM/FOR, substring SIMILAR ESCAPE, overlay PLACING FROM FOR, position IN, strpos

sql: SELECT trim(BOTH 'x' FROM 'xhellox'), ltrim('   hi'), rtrim('hi   '), btrim('  hi  ')

note: ESCAPE clause requires exactly one character — multi-char escape is a runtime error
